description: One item: what it is, its layout, who may install it, its thumbnail (the store screenshot, as an image and a URL), and, when the caller may, its registry entry with the files and their code.

code.description: Include the registry entry with the code when the caller may have it. Default true; false to only look.

name.description: The item's store number, as list_items and search_items return it, e.g. "hero-12" or "template-home".

thumbnail.description: Include the screenshot as an image. Default true; false gives only its URL.

name: show_item
title: Show a themes.dev UI item
